comments.text: Hi Cory……I know you’ll probably never see this comment, but I’ve been building up the courage to actually make a comment on one of your videos for years now, and I finally am trying to. I’ve been watching you ever since 2015, where I first discovered ur Geometry Dash playlist, and found your charisma, goofiness, and humor without profanity and excessive cussing so entertaining and fun, and ever since then, I was hooked, as I would spend every Christmas rewatching your LeBron James Cranberry video ( lol, wrong title but you know what I mean), and rewatching old playlists like your Walking Dead and Resident Evil ones when you went on your hiatuses. Through my childhood years as a kid, you were such a positive and wonderful influnce on me, making me laugh until tears fell when I came back stressed from school or had a rough day. You made the eight just as little lighter, and for those moments, I will never forget. Although I’m now 18 and in college, and can’t binge watch you like I used to back then, ur videos will always hold a special place in my heart, thank you for being such an amazing person Cory. It’s amazing seeing one of the YouTube OGs still grinding and getting over a million views and over a hundred thousand likes in a matter of a few hours. You are and always will be my favorite content creator of all time, and I hope this doesn’t come off as glazing or too much, but for real man, I really cherish the impact ur videos had on me. I know you will probably never see this comment, even though I kinda wish you did (okay, more than kinda), but regardless, god bless your family, and thank you for blessing me with endless laughter and joy, helping me and my siblings connect and relate with our common love as kids, finishing homework early so we could watch ur videos before bed time. Peace and love Cory. This might sound crazy……but I hope one day…….i get to meet you……and tell you face-to-face how much you changed people’s lives by being who you are, because what you do matters. God bless you Cory, and I wish you many more prosperous years in this life, and above all, peace and happiness. Praying for you man, god bless.❤
